name: PandaConquest Companion 0.1.1
body:
### Fixed

- After an addon update, the first game session now receives your server data (captured POIs, tickets) instead of starting with an empty map until the next launch.

Self-contained Windows 64-bit archive (nothing to install, no .NET needed): extract it into your World of Warcraft folder (the one with `WoW.exe`); it adds the `PandaConquest-Companion` folder and `PandaConquestLauncher.dll`. Then either tick `PandaConquestLauncher.dll` in the Octo launcher's mods, or run `PandaConquest-Companion\PandaConquest.Companion.exe` once: from then on the game starts the companion. To update, extract the new archive over the old one: your settings and key are kept elsewhere. Unsigned: Windows SmartScreen may ask for confirmation on first launch.

SHA-256 of `PandaConquest-Companion-0.1.1-win-x64.zip`:

```text
8c59010ce65d51b727b0f7bc25aee0829c271eeda2577995266eae7774cb038b
```
